about: Ground the world stands bodies on. Absent `ground` option = the flat floor of world.json, unchanged. Every number names its source. Nothing is hard-coded in src/ground.mjs.

flat.source: world.json floor row (same box, same friction): angle 0 builds the identical body, so its per-tick hash equals the default floor

slope15.source: Strategy 2026-10-28 (V3 terrain: hills and ridges): gentle slope; friction = world.json floor

slope30.source: Strategy 2026-10-28 (V3 terrain): steep ridge; friction = world.json floor. tan(30) = 0.577 is under friction 0.8, so a resting rigid body holds (the angle that starts sliding is atan(0.8) = 38.7)

plane.source: world.json floor box: half-height 0.5, convex radius 0.05. max_angle_deg: own, a slope steeper than 60 is a wall, not ground

probe.source: own: groundMax looks at the centre and 8 points around the footprint circle; enough for a hill whose features are wider than a body

heightfield.source: own: a sampled height function `groundHeight(x, z)` from the game, one sample per cell_m over the same 100 m square as the floor. Jolt compresses each 2x2 block against its own min/max, so 8 bits is well under a millimetre on a 0.5 m cell. friction = world.json floor

settle.drop_height_source: own: spawn the body this far above the highest ground under its footprint, so it lands on its own weight
settle.footprint_source: own: radius searched for the highest ground under the spawn (arms out / dog length)
settle.max_settle_source: own: ragdolls on the flat floor freeze inside 15 s (test/chain-dog-drone.test.mjs steps 15 s); a slope gets 20 s
settle.clearance_source: Jolt's default penetration slop 0.02 m, plus 0.01 m for the heightfield triangle interpolation and float32 poses
settle.hold_source: own: once asleep a body must not move at all over 5 s (a sleeping body is not stepped); 1 mm is float32 noise
settle.max_slide_source: own: a limp body that lands on a 30 degree slope may roll and slide, but must stop inside the runway; measured on the VPS, see the PR body
